caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a standing figure dressed in clothing suggestive of indigenous attire, including a headdress with several large feathers. The figure has long hair and is wearing a tunic that reaches to the knees, with leggings and moccasin-like footwear. One arm is bent at the elbow with the hand extended outward and the other arm is at the side, gripping a long object that appears to be a staff or a piece of wood that rests on the ground. The figure stands on a square pedestal with slightly slanted sides, and the base has indistinct inscriptions or writing, some of which appear to read “CIGARS.” The overall color of the statue includes muted earth tones such as browns, yellows, and greens, with some white, blue, and red accents, giving it a weathered and patinated look. The pedestal is mainly gray with blue and green areas. The background of the drawing is plain and unadorned, with a light cream color.
title: Cigar Store Indian
